$comment: Structural Draft 2020-12 validation alone is insufficient; the required V2 semantic vocabulary and explicit reference validator enforce canonical byte, digest, attribution, ordering and scalar rules. Data validation never qualifies native admission or authority.

AllTargetValidityV2.description: Asserted effect on a target; native admission checks its validity.
AllTargetValidityV2.title: AllTargetValidityV2

BoundSourceBasisV2.description: Inert source-binding identities, not source permissions.
BoundSourceBasisV2.title: BoundSourceBasisV2

ChangeFromV2.description: Exact change transition; historical projection is runtime-owned.
ChangeFromV2.title: ChangeFromV2

CorrectionOfV2.description: Exact target assertion and correction effect.
CorrectionOfV2.title: CorrectionOfV2

IntervalValidityV2.description: An explicitly based half-open effective interval.
IntervalValidityV2.title: IntervalValidityV2

OverlapEffectV2.description: Explicit interval; actual authorized overlap is runtime-owned.
OverlapEffectV2.title: OverlapEffectV2

OwnerVersionEvidenceBinding.description: Immutable structural assertions about one exact message representation.
OwnerVersionEvidenceBinding.title: OwnerVersionEvidenceBinding

ReplaceFromEffectV2.description: Replacement boundary, without claiming historical falsity.
ReplaceFromEffectV2.title: ReplaceFromEffectV2

StandingValidityV2.description: Explicit asserted standing validity; authority remains external.
StandingValidityV2.title: StandingValidityV2

SupersedesV2.description: Exact replacement with independent reason/effect semantics.
SupersedesV2.title: SupersedesV2

UnknownValidityV2.description: No dates are known or silently inferred.
UnknownValidityV2.title: UnknownValidityV2

UserReviewedBasisV2.description: Reported review basis, not a runtime approval receipt.
UserReviewedBasisV2.title: UserReviewedBasisV2

WorkspaceExceptionToV2.description: Asserted workspace exception, never a target-read capability.
WorkspaceExceptionToV2.title: WorkspaceExceptionToV2
